rows.explainer: Mortality reduction "Compared to conventional care, KMC significantly reduced the risks of mortality (relative risk [RR] 0.68; 95% CI 0.53 to 0.86; 11 trials, 10505 infants; high certainty evidence) at discharge or 28 days of age" (n=10,505 infants) https://gh.bmj.com/content/8/6/e010728

rows.label: Estimate 2 - Mortality reduction effect due to KC (by 28 days)
rows.explainer: Mortality reduction "Kangaroo care could reduce the primary clinical outcome of mortality between enrollment and 28 days (RR: 0.80, 95% Cl: 0.71–0.91, p < 0.01)." (n=17,668) https://doi.org/10.3389%2Ffped.2023.1067183

rows.label: Estimate 3 - Mortality reduction effect due to KC (by 28 days)
rows.explainer: Mortality reduction "Kangaroo care resulted in significantly lower mortality (OR: 0.65, 95% CI: 0.44-0.97, p = 0.03) in the short term (within 2 months, I2 = 71%)" (n=19,980) https://doi.org/10.17219/acem/153417

rows.label: Estimate 4 - Mortality reduction effect due to KC (by 28 days)
rows.explainer: Mortality reduction "From randomisation to 28 days, 119 (11.3%) of 1,051 neonates in the intervention group [KC] and 134 (12.8%) of 1,049 neonates in the control group died (RR 0.88 [0.71-1.09]; p=0.23).” (n=2100) https://doi.org/10.1016/s0140-6736(24)00064-3

rows.label: DALYs averted per dollar
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).

summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 update of its estimate for a new charity scaling up kangaroo care for low birth weight babies by embedding it in hospitals, modelled for Pakistan. The idea First Embrace was founded to run (First Embrace works in Nigeria). A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: the final cost per DALY averted per successful charity (about $50).

theoretical.reason: Ambitious Impact's estimate of the idea, written before the charity existed; not based on the charity's own results.
theoretical.runs: First Embrace runs hospital-embedded kangaroo care in Kano State, Nigeria (since February 2026); AIM modelled Pakistan.
